acceptance: a predicate run under EVOLVE_FLEET=1 sees no EVOLVE_FLEET (test)
one go-test env projection is used by every production go-test spawner (AST pin)

consumed.resolution: Predicates now run in the suite's own environment: predicateEnv starts from ipcenv.Scrub(os.Environ()) and adds only EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT, the worktree-root key and CHANGED_PACKAGES (a real go test under EVOLVE_FLEET=1 sees none of the lane keys); acsrunner and both releasepreflight go-test runners moved onto the same projection. The AST pin across every spawner, the tmux pane's cycle-state override and the cycle-state spelling audit are filed as follow-ups go-test-env-projection-pinned and lane-cycle-state-override-leaks.

fix: Give the acs suite an explicit env policy: ipcenv.Scrub(os.Environ()) plus a named allowlist of the EVOLVE_* keys predicates read on purpose (for example EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT). Route acsrunner, ciparity and releasepreflight through one shared go-test env projection instead of adding more per-site scrubs.
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: This spawner leaked lane IPC env into predicates and halted the loop at cycle 1700 (2026-09-26), and the remaining keys (EVOLVE_FLEET, scope, width) can false-RED fleet-sensitive packages the same way through whole-package meta-predicates.
summary: Found root-causing cycle 1700 (2026-09-26). internal/acssuite/acssuite.go builds the predicate `go test` env from os.Environ() plus extras, unscrubbed, so every predicate and every inner `go test` a predicate shells inherits the lane's EVOLVE_FLEET, scope and width keys. This is the 2026-09-14 incident (ship gate ran go test in the lane IPC env) through a different spawner. The cycle-state half of the leak is closed at the resolver by paths.CycleStateFileFor, so a fixture evolve dir no longer sees the lane's file. EVOLVE_FLEET still reaches tests that branch on fleet mode (the 09-14 GIT_FLEET_REBASE_NEEDED goldens). acsrunner, ciparity and releasepreflight spawn go test unscrubbed too. Architect review of the cycle-state scoping fix (2026-09-26) adds: (a) EGPS predicates also get EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT=<plane> plus the lane override, so anything a predicate resolves through the PLANE root still reaches the live lane file — drop CycleStateFileKey from the predicate env (acs/cycle1690 and cycle1694 already strip it by hand); (b) a tmux pane inherits the env of whichever process started the tmux server, not its own lane, so `evolve` commands an agent runs against P/.evolve may honor a sibling lane override — the bridge should export or unset CycleStateFileKey in the pane next to the EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT export (driver_tmux_boot.go); (c) direct cycle-state spellings bypass the resolver in inboxmover.go:133, gc/discover.go:141, gc/worktrees.go:226, ship/verify.go:329, ship/gitops.go:237, ship/native_explanation_gate.go:29, cmd_syncmain.go:122 — audit each (some are deliberate).
title: EGPS acs suite passes the lane's IPC env (EVOLVE_FLEET, scope keys) to every predicate
